result.topic_en: Calculations toward the Riemann–Siegel formula: Gaussian integrals and theta-type transformations, a saddle-point integral of $e^{-nn\pi x}x^{ti/2-3/4}$, an integral expanded in Gamma (Π) functions, and a power-series recursion for a differential equation in the coefficients of an asymptotic expansion.
result.transcription:
$e^{-nn\pi x}$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-yy}\partial y=\sqrt{\pi}$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\pi \frac{yy}{x}}\partial y = x^{+\frac12}$
$y+nxi$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\frac{\pi yy}{x} [-+-] 2n\pi y i + nn\pi x}\partial y = x^{\frac12}$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\frac{\pi yy}{x}} e^{-2n\pi y i}\partial y = x^{\frac12} e^{-nn\pi x}$

$\int_0^\infty e^{-nn\pi x} x^{\frac{ti}{2}-\frac34}\partial x = e^{-nn\pi i}\int e^{-nn\pi y - \frac{t\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{8}i+\left(\frac{ti}{2}-\frac34\right)\log(1-yi)}\partial y$

$-nn\pi x+\log x\,\frac{ti}{2}$
$-yi+\frac{yy}{2}+\frac{y^3}{3}i-\frac{y^4}{4}-\frac{y^5}{5}i+\frac{y^6}{6}$
$-nn\pi+\frac1x\frac{ti}{2}=0 \qquad n=\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}-\varsigma-\frac12$
[-$x=\frac{2nn\pi}{t}i$-] $\qquad nn=\frac{t}{2\pi}-2(\varsigma+\frac12)\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}+(\varsigma+\frac12)^2 \quad \frac{ti}{4}yy$
[-$x=-i+y\ldots(1-yi)$-]
$x=\frac{ti}{2\pi nn}=i \qquad x=i+y=i(1-yi)$
$\int_0^\infty$

$\int_\infty^\infty e^{2ty-yy}(-y)^\gamma\partial y = \sin\gamma\pi\, i\sum\frac{\Pi\frac{\gamma-n-1}{2}}{\Pi n}(2t)^n$
$=e^{-tt}\int_\infty^\infty e^{-zz}(-(t+z))^\gamma\partial z=\sin\gamma\pi\, i\, e^{-tt}\sum\frac{\Pi\frac{\gamma-n-1}{2}\; t^n\,\Pi(\gamma)}{\Pi n\;\Pi(\gamma-n)}$
$2^{-n}\Pi\frac{\gamma-n}{2}\,\Pi\frac{\gamma-n-1}{2}=\Pi(\gamma-n)$ [?]
$\Pi\frac{\gamma-n}{2}=[-\ldots-]\,\Pi\left(\frac{n-\gamma}{2}-1\right)$

$\left(\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}+\frac12\right)\log(\alpha+y)-\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}y+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}=\log u$
$\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}\frac{1}{\alpha+y}-\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}+\frac{y}{2\pi i}=\frac{\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}}{u}$
$-\frac12+\frac{yy}{2\pi i}=\frac{\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}}{u}\,\alpha+y$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}(\alpha+y)+\left(\frac12-\frac{yy}{2\pi i}\right)u=0$
$u=\sum_0^\infty a_n y^n$
$\sum_0^\infty a_n [-\ldots-](n+\frac12)y^n+\sum a_n n\alpha y^{n-1}-\frac{1}{2\pi i}\sum a_n y^{n+2}$

[-$n+1$-]$a_{n+1}=-\frac1\alpha a_n(n+\frac12)+\frac{1}{\alpha 2\pi i}a_{n-2} \qquad a_n n!=b_n$

$b_{n+1}=-\frac1\alpha b_n(n+\frac12)+\frac{1}{\alpha 2\pi i}b_{n-2}\,n(n-1)$
$v=\sum_0^\infty b_n y^{n+2} \qquad \frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}=\sum_0^\infty b_{n-2}\,n\,n-1\,y^{n-2}$
[-$\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\ldots y^{n-2}$-] $\qquad \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\sum b_n(n+2)y^{n+1}$
$=\sum b_{n-2}y^n \qquad v=\sum b_{n+1}y^{n+3}$

$v=-\frac1\alpha\left(yy\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}-\frac32 y v\right)+\frac{1}{\alpha 2\pi i}\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}y^5+yy$

$d_0=ke^{\tau+\theta i}$
$\alpha=i\sqrt{2\pi t} \qquad d_1=k\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2\pi t}}{\pi}e^{\tau+\theta i}+[-\ldots e^{-\frac{t\pi}{2}-\tau+\theta i}-]\right)+2\sqrt{4\pi}\,e^{-\frac{t\pi}{2}-\tau+\theta i}$

$d_1=d_0\,? -\frac{\sqrt{2\pi t}}{\pi}\left(1-2\pi\sqrt{\frac2t}\,e^{-\frac{t\pi}{2}-2\tau}\right)$

$e^{+\frac{\pi}{4}i-\frac{t\pi}{2}}$
